lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's five over seven? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 5/7? Nope!

lines.text: A star b means a plus b, over one plus a times b.
lines.caption: a star b means a plus b, over 1 plus a times b.

lines.text: Find the value of this whole chain.
lines.caption: Find the value of this whole chain.

lines.text: Step one: one over two, star one over three. That makes five over seven!
lines.caption: Step one: 1/2, star 1/3. That makes 5/7!

lines.text: But that's only step one! Star one over four, and you get nine over eleven.
lines.caption: But that's only step one! Star 1/4, and you get 9/11.

lines.text: Still not done! One last star, with one over five.
lines.caption: Still not done! One last star, with 1/5.

lines.text: Fifty-six over sixty-four. That's seven over eight!
lines.caption: 56/64. That's 7/8!

lines.text: Five over seven was the trap. It stops too early.
lines.caption: 5/7 was the trap. It stops too early.

lines.text: Did you get seven over eight? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 7/8? Tell me below!
